title: session.rs: AUTH on port 587 cleartext sends 534 but continues session — no forced disconnect
description: session.rs AUTH handler: when is_tls=false and a client sends AUTH, the response is 534 and the session continues. RFC 4954 recommends 530 or 534 and the client should not retry. However, a pipelining client that sends EHLO+AUTH+MAIL FROM simultaneously will get: 250 (EHLO), 534 (AUTH), and then the MAIL FROM is processed against session state that is still Greeted. If credential_store is non-empty, the MAIL FROM will get 530 Authentication required. If empty, the MAIL FROM is accepted. This creates a confusing error sequence for pipelining clients. More importantly, if AUTH fails with 534 but the session keeps running, a client can try AUTH multiple times with different mechanisms without any rate limiting or disconnection.
